html: † אַכַּד n.pr.loc. Akkad Gn 10:10 וַתְּהִי רֵאשִׁית מַמְלַכְתּוֹ בָּבֶל וְאֶרֶךְ וְא׳ וְכַלְנֶה בְּאֶרֶץ שִׁנְעָֽר׃; name of a city in Northern (?) Babylonia; = Bab. Akkadi, mostly name of land or district, but also of city, v. Hilpr Freibrief Neb. I, col. ii, l. 50; location uncertain; on possible identif. or confusion with Agade (Agate, Agane?), city of Sargon I, cf. DlPa 198 & K 19 f. COT Gn 10:10 Tiele Gesch. i.76 f.
